verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own materials claim multi-agent teamwork: auto team formation that assembles agents for a task, multiple agents working on Pages with shared context, and a coordinating agent that "hires, schedules, reports on" an AI team. A homepage line says a CAO "dispatched 50 agents" across 500 issues, which suggests parallel splitting of work. These are marketing-level claims without usage docs explaining how work is decomposed or parallelized. missing for 10: documentation of subagent/swarm mechanics (task splitting, parallel execution, result aggregation), any agent-to-agent protocol, independent or hands-on corroboration.
